consequence.statement: Issuers will now retry more quickly when their linked Secret is updated, reducing back-off timeout delays.

original.statement: Cert-manager issuers will now retry more quickly when their linked Secret is updated, fixing an issue that caused high back-off timeout delays.

decision.reason: [ev-10c8b1c28d66] describes a bugfix: when an issuer's linked Secret is updated, the issuer now retries sooner instead of waiting out a long back-off timeout. The evidence says nothing fails, gets rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating. Only the retry timing changes, so behavior-change (review) with low severity is supported. The proposed statement matches the evidence.
